baudrate=115200
boot_by_commit=if itest.s ${sw_commit} == 0;then run set_act0;run ub0;else run set_act1;run ub1;fi
boot_by_tryactive=if itest.s ${sw_tryactive} == 0;then setenv sw_tryactive 2;setenv sw_active 0;saveenv;run en_wdt;run ub0;else setenv sw_tryactive 2;setenv sw_active 1;saveenv;run en_wdt;run ub1;fi
bootargs_base=console=ttyS0,115200
bootcmd=if itest.s ${sw_tryactive} == 2; then run boot_by_commit;else run boot_by_tryactive;fi
bootdelay=1
cfg_name=ubi_Config
check_vol=if run chk_volume; then ; else if run ubipart; then if run chk_volume; then ; else echo ${current_vol} no exist; fi; fi; fi
chk_volume=ubi check ${current_vol}
current_vol=ubi_r1
en_wdt=mw b8003268 e7c00000
erase_cfgfs=ubi clean ${cfg_name}
erase_env=spi_nand erase ${fl_env} ${fl_env_sz} && spi_nand erase ${fl_env2} ${fl_env_sz}
ethact=LUNA GMAC
ethaddr=00:E0:4C:86:70:01
fileaddr=80000000
filesize=807000
fl_boot_sz=c0000
fl_cfgfs=0
fl_cfgfs_sz=0
fl_env=c0000
fl_env2=e0000
fl_env_sz=20000
fl_kernel1=0
fl_kernel1_sz=0
fl_kernel2=0
fl_kernel2_sz=0
fl_kernel_sz=600000
fl_rootfs1=0
fl_rootfs1_sz=0
fl_rootfs2=0
fl_rootfs2_sz=0
fl_ubidevice=100000
fl_ubidevice_sz=7c80000
freeAddr=83000000
ftfp_base=83c60000
fx1000_init=mw bb000084 00000048
ipaddr=192.168.1.3
more_args=ubi.mtd=${ubi_mtd} root=${root_mtd} rootfs=squashfs
mtddevname=boot
mtddevnum=0
mtdids=nand0=spinand
mtdparts=mtdparts=spinand:768K(boot),128K(env),128K(env2),127488K(ubi_device)
mtdparts0=mtdparts=spinand:768K(boot),128K(env),128K(env2),127488K(ubi_device),4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,0G@0G(linux),0G@0G(rootfs)
mtdparts1=mtdparts=spinand:768K(boot),128K(env),128K(env2),127488K(ubi_device),4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,4K@0ro,0G@0G(linux),0G@0G(rootfs)
mupgrade_en=1
netmask=255.255.255.0
partition=nand0,0
process0=run ubipart && ubi read ${freeAddr} ubi_k0 ${fl_kernel_sz}
process1=run ubipart && ubi read ${freeAddr} ubi_k1 ${fl_kernel_sz}
root_mtd=31:6
serverip=192.168.1.66
set_act0=if itest.s ${sw_active} != 0;then setenv sw_active 0;saveenv;fi
set_act1=if itest.s ${sw_active} != 1;then setenv sw_active 1;saveenv;fi
set_commit0=if itest.s ${sw_commit} != 0;then setenv sw_commit 0;saveenv;fi
setbootargs=setenv bootargs ${bootargs_base} ${more_args} ${mtdparts}
setmoreargs=set more_args ubi.mtd=${ubi_mtd} root=${root_mtd} rootfs=squashfs
sgmii_init=mw bb000084 00000044
stderr=serial
stdin=serial
stdout=serial
sw_active=0
sw_commit=0
sw_crc0=f9a1783b
sw_crc1=f9a1783b
sw_tryactive=2
sw_version0=V4.3.0-190222 -- Fri Feb 22 11:3
sw_version1=V4.3.0-190222 -- Fri Feb 22 11:3
ub0=set root_mtd 31:6 && run process0 setmoreargs setbootargs; bootm ${freeAddr}
ub1=set root_mtd 31:8 && run process1 setmoreargs setbootargs; bootm ${freeAddr}
ubi_device_img_name=98D_ubi_device.ubi
ubi_mtd=3
ubi_mtd_name=ubi_device
ubipart=ubi part nand0,${ubi_mtd}
upb=tftp ${ftfp_base} encode_uboot.img && crc32 ${fileaddr} ${filesize} && spi_nand erase 0x0 ${fl_boot_sz} && spi_nand write.raw ${fileaddr} 0x0 ${filesize}
updev=tftp ${ftfp_base} ${ubi_device_img_name} && spi_nand erase ${fl_ubidevice} ${fl_ubidevice_sz} && spi_nand write  ${fileaddr} ${fl_ubidevice} ${filesize} && run set_commit0
upe=tftp ${ftfp_base} uboot-env-98d-eng.bin && spi_nand erase ${fl_env} ${fl_env_sz} && spi_nand write ${fileaddr} ${fl_env} ${fl_env_sz} && spi_nand erase ${fl_env2} ${fl_env_sz} && spi_nand write ${fileaddr} ${fl_env2} ${fl_env_sz}
upk=set current_vol ubi_k0 && run check_vol && tftp ${ftfp_base} uImage && ubi write ${ftfp_base} ubi_k0 ${filesize}
upk1=set current_vol ubi_k1 && run check_vol && tftp ${ftfp_base} uImage && ubi write ${ftfp_base} ubi_k1 ${filesize}
upr=set current_vol ubi_r0 && run check_vol  && tftp ${ftfp_base} rootfs && ubi write ${ftfp_base} ubi_r0 ${filesize}
upr1=set current_vol ubi_r1 && run check_vol  && tftp ${ftfp_base} rootfs && ubi write ${ftfp_base} ubi_r1 ${filesize}
upt=tftp 80000000 img.tar && upimgtar ${fileaddr} ${filesize}
upv=tftp 80000000 vm.img;upvmimg ${fileaddr}
yk=loady 80000000 && cp.b 80000000 81000000 ${filesize} && cmp.b 80000000 81000000 ${filesize} && spi_nand erase ${fl_kernel1} ${fl_kernel1_sz} && spi_nand write 80000000 ${fl_kernel1} ${filesize}
yr=loady 80000000 && cp.b 80000000 81000000 ${filesize} && cmp.b 80000000 81000000 ${filesize} && spi_nand erase ${fl_rootfs1} ${fl_rootfs1_sz} && spi_nand write 80000000 ${fl_rootfs1} ${filesize}
yu=loady 80000000 && cp.b 80000000 81000000 ${filesize} && cmp.b 80000000 81000000 ${filesize} && spi_nand erase 0 ${fl_boot_sz} && spi_nand write.raw 80000000 0 ${filesize}
